title: Development blog video for an Incremental Horde, Goliath Necro
author: Busy-Ad-9681
selftext:
I've seen some posts asking about how to develop a game with AI and I think something like this might be helpful to some people starting. 

I've started this one in the 22th of Oct with a 9-5 job and a baby. The game can be now completed, has an intro and ending, is all on my web if you want to test it along with a bunch of other projects [https://goliathstudios.net/](https://goliathstudios.net/)

  
Helpful stuff for a first iteration:

1. ask for a .bat file to play it, so you don't have to deal with cmd or others
2. For UI changes or art tweaks, ask him to present it in 'Artifacts' so you can edit them and talk to it about each of the images it creates
3. Give it references if you have any
4. Ask him for a Debug menu to iterate and a hotkey to give it feedback as you test: "pause the game, take a screenshot, let me write a comment."

  
For the intro and outro, covers, banners, etc., I used comfyUI with KREA and H3 minimax. You can ask Claude to set it up. I asked for artifacts there too, it presents me the characters first, then the first frames, finally the video. I left notes all the way. Music was also done this way

Trailer was made by Claude too, just recording old versions of the project.

Make it document things, so other projects you start can take advantage of the ones you've made already.

I'm not profiting on any of my projects, just focusing on learning right now. If you have any questions please let me know
